llm_response.reason: The website https://www.isabellageri.shop/ mimics the official Melvin & Hamilton brand store but is hosted on an unrelated domain. It displays multiple scam indicators: there is no legitimate business identification, no physical address or verifiable contact, only a form, and the privacy policy is generic without legal compliance details. Products and layouts match official collections, likely copied, attempting to mislead buyers. The presence of SSL certificate warnings reinforces untrustworthiness. All observed traits (impersonation, lack of business info, dubious privacy policy, and mismatched domain) strongly support the conclusion that this is a fake online shopping scam.
